text: brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātīti . sattamaṃ . [222] cakkhuṃ bhikkhave dukkhaṃ yopi hetu yopi paccayo cakkhussa uppādāya sopi dukkho dukkhasambhūtaṃ bhikkhave cakkhuṃ kuto sukhaṃ bhavissati .pe. jivhā dukkhā yopi hetu yopi paccayo jivhāya uppādāya sopi dukkho dukkhasambhūtā bhikkhave jivhā kuto sukhā bhavissati .pe. mano dukkho yopi hetu yopi paccayo manassa uppādāya sopi dukkho dukkhasambhūto bhikkhave mano kuto sukho bhavissati . evaṃ passaṃ .pe. nāparaṃ itthattāyāti
